headline: S&P 500 down 5 straight, 4 Fed officials back hikes, record $81bn IPO trades today
stance: Fed speakers leaned toward more hikes after a fifth straight S&P 500 loss. Jobless claims and Philly Fed at 8:30.

news.head: Anthropic prices IPO at $83, raising $81bn
news.body: 980m shares, the largest offering on record. Lists on Nasdaq today as ANT (~6:40pm ET).

news.head: Palo Alto raises outlook, buys Applied Compute
news.body: $4.5bn deal announced with fiscal Q1 results (~7:07pm ET). Outlook raised on threat-driven demand (~8:02pm ET).

news.head: Nvidia outlook cut to stable after Huang exit
news.body: Rating agency cites strategy and policy uncertainty (~5:36pm ET). Report says a $500bn Wall Street financing pledge did not materialize (~4:41am ET).

implications: Four Fed officials want more hikes with the S&P 500 down five sessions. Equities get no help from the Fed before December 9.
Small caps broke their 200-day trend Wednesday with spec Russell 2000 longs at the 99th %ile. That is positioning, not a sell signal.

watch.head: Walmart reports before the open
watch.body: Holiday outlook and consumer spending in focus.

watch.head: Jobless claims and Philly Fed, 8:30
watch.body: First labor data since Fed speakers backed more hikes. Fed balance sheet at 4:30pm.

watch.head: Iran strike decision
watch.body: Trump weighing new strikes; Israel pressing for a 4- to 7-day air campaign (~10:10pm ET).

watch.head: UMich final sentiment, Nov 20, 10:00
watch.body: Household inflation expectations, final November read.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Four Fed officials backed more hikes Wednesday. Waller floated 50bp to break a 3% inflation mindset (~7:28pm ET).
Brent near $92 overnight (~11:55pm ET). IEA estimates the Gulf war has cost 2.8bn barrels of supply (~4:00am ET).
Australia unemployment 4.9% vs 4.7% expected; AUD below 0.6700 (~7:42pm ET). Ueda says BOJ keeps raising rates (~8:16pm ET).
sections.positioning: Spec euro longs 1st %ile, 7 weeks at the extreme, standing. Spec 2y Treasury longs 93rd %ile, 15 weeks.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P 500 fell a fifth straight session Wednesday, its longest losing run since June (~7:14pm ET).
Russell 2000 50-day average crossed below its 200-day Wednesday (~6:12pm ET).
VXN 33.12 vs VIX 24.56 at Wednesday's close. Tech vol carries an 8.6-point premium.
sections.positioning: Spec Nasdaq 100 longs 89th %ile, down 7 points on the week. Spec Russell 2000 longs 99th %ile, 6 weeks, standing.

single_name.note: Score 4, two sessions on the screen. Two insider rules fired, latest filing Nov 17. Trades above its 200-day line.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: Listed BDCs 0.87x NAV, median, at Wednesday's close, from 0.92x Tuesday.
ETFs tracking CDS on AI-linked issuers are headed to market (~6:38pm ET).
SOFR-OIS 4bp Tuesday. No funding strain into this week's record equity issuance.
sections.positioning: No credit COT extreme. Dealer IG inventory mid-range, 73rd %ile of 3 years.
